content.text: Clear picture: no deploys, errors are PaymentProviderFailed with io-pay returning 503, and io-pay is a third-party dependency.

hypotheses.subject: io-pay
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's account page calls the third-party payment provider io-pay (api.io-pay.example) while rendering. Starting 17:58Z, io-pay began returning HTTP 503 for card lookups, driving io-shop's error rate to 100% and p50/p95/p99 latency up by ~40x (waiting on the failing calls). No deploys or config changes occurred in the prior day, ruling out a bad deployment or config change.

supporting_evidence.claim: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-19845-4-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:96
account page error rate at 100.00% over the last minute
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - Holds the card Io charges. Called while the account page renders, because Io has never stored a card number
p50_ms jumped from 44 to 2046 and p99_ms from 369 to 2384 at the onset minute
